segments.narration: One monk wrote a book that weighs 75 kilos. Bohemia, early twelve hundreds, and it takes two people to lift.
It stands ninety-two centimetres tall. Three hundred and ten leaves survive, and the hides of about a hundred and sixty animals went into it.
The handwriting does not change across the whole thing. One scribe, working for years without his letters drifting.
Then you reach page two ninety. A full-page devil, half a metre tall, crouched and staring straight out.
Legend says he sold his soul to finish it in one night. Scholars estimate around twenty years of ordinary, patient work.
